messages:
maria-peopleops: Heads-up — new intern (Bengaluru) starts Mon 2024-11-04. Candidate is remote in IST, not a US resident. Need plan for I-9 / verification, BG intake, benefits eligibility, laptop courier, and a timezone-friendly orientation. @taro @eli-hr

Taro: Hiring manager here. Candidate is an early-career contractor (student internship). No SSN, not eligible for US I-9. Wants access to code on day 1 for shadowing tasks.

eli-hr: Quick policy note: non-US workers do NOT complete US I-9. Options: (A) payroll via local entity if we have one, or (B) engage as contractor and collect tax/KYC (e.g., W-8BEN for non-US independent contractors) + local ID. Benefits: generally not eligible for US benefits unless local programs available.

maria-peopleops: Treat as contractor until payroll confirms. For BG: our vendor supports India but requires explicit consent + local phone. @onboard-bot can you generate consent link and vendor kickoff? Also need laptop courier ETA and an async-first orientation plan + buddy in IST.

onboard-bot: Consent link created and emailed to candidate (2024-10-28T09:12Z). Vendor: Checkr International. Candidate prompted for local phone number and govt ID scan.

dev-ops: Laptop shipping OK via DHL Express to Bengaluru. ETA 3-5 business days after label creation. Will image machine with dev image and disable VPN/prod certs until BG clears. Please provide local shipping address.

tara-dev: I can be buddy. Suggest two 30-min overlap slots Wed/Thu 11:30–12:00 IST. I'll prepare a short "Day 1" checklist and a 15-min pre-recorded walkthrough for async viewing.

eli-hr: BG timing note: India checks often 7–10 business days if we need employment/education verification. Recommend gating production creds until BG status == cleared. For initial work, provide sanitized dev data and a limited-role account.

Taro: Agreed. Please add onboarding flag to restrict secrets/prod services until BG cleared. Also confirm if contractor needs a signed contractor agreement and invoice cadence.

maria-peopleops: Action items: (1) @onboard-bot: consent link + BG kick (done), (2) @dev-ops: ship label once address confirmed and lock VPN/prod creds until cleared, (3) @tara-dev: buddy + 1:1 slots + pre-recorded walkthrough, (4) @eli-hr: send contractor tax/KYC form (W-8BEN or local equivalent) and contractor agreement template. I'll post orientation recording and APAC benefits Q&A: https://redwood-internal/onboarding/apac-onboard

Taro: Candidate confirmed address in Bengaluru and accepted DHL. Also requested an optional "live" orientation recording they can watch before 1:1 to maximize overlap.

maria-peopleops: Will upload recording and send calendar invites for buddy sessions in IST. Adding a note to the hire ticket to reassess payroll vs contractor if the engagement extends past 3 months. :thumbsup:
